dedupe_keys.name: improving harmonic measurements with instrument transformers a comparison among two techniques

description: Giovanni D'Avanzo and colleagues publish this resource through the source community. The study numerically compares two digital-signal-processing techniques for mitigating inductive-transformer nonlinearities: SINDICOMP and frequency-domain polynomial harmonic compensation. Coverage uses voltage waveforms representative of normal power-system operation. The model distinguishes dynamic filtering from iron-core nonlinear distortion when assessing measured harmonics. Exact waveforms and implementation coefficients are not exposed in the abstract. Related spreadsheet records provide outputs from other named compensation studies without proving independent validation of this particular simulation. Zenodo supplies the descriptive publication with open access under cc-by-4.0. The publication does not establish public access to an implementation or its separate licence. A limitation is that complete implementation or measurement settings cannot be reconstructed from descriptive metadata alone. Related experimental components and publications retain their distinct roles; separate deposits are not assumed to provide independent observations.
